author: V4 adversarial verifier
status: pre-registered before any ladder prediction (cons/unf2/rnd2/multiref/p1ep4/fuse2_s43/s44) was in data/results
metric: object_prf.py ktvic_block vs the union of the 5 test references, 558 images; M = unique lexicon classes per caption; intervals are [point, lo, hi]

models.L: count from target length (r in [1.028, 1.102] short, 1.028+-0.03 detailed) + one learner frontier (frontier invariance); tolerances: +-0.035 count (2 seed SD), +-1.0 P/R
models.T: A1 implicit threshold, ideal learner: count ratios = ratios of E#{pi > tau}

p1ep4_s42-short.frontier_residual_P: point in [-1.5, +1.0]; H0 rejected only if the 95% CI excludes 0
p1ep4_s42-short.T_model: an ideal (better-fit) learner thresholds pi at 0.505: count falls toward the majority set (1.24 on test); L predicts no fall below 1.63

multiref_s42-short.frontier_residual_P_H0: point in [-1.0, +1.0]; H0 rejected only if the 95% CI (~+-2 P) excludes 0
multiref_s42-short.H1_variance_channel: frontier residual P >= +1.0 with a CI excluding 0 (A1 proxy: +3.0 mP net)
multiref_s42-short.A1_stated: recall <= P1 recall - 2.0 (A1 7a.1: multiref ~4 recall points below P1)

cons_s42-short.discriminator: M/M_P1 <= 1.30 supports L; >= 1.40 supports T (ideal ratio 1.47 train / 1.55 test)
cons_s42-short.H1_bleed_over: unsupported mentions/caption (1v4, A1 unsupported.py) <= 0.52 vs 0.57 for fuse2-short AND frontier residual P >= fuse2-short's (+0.34) + 1.0 with a CI excluding 0

unf2_s42-short.discriminator: unf2/cons count >= 0.97 supports L; <= 0.95 supports T

rnd2_s42-short.note: same short rows as fuse2 (consensus); H0 = fuse2_s42-short

structural.short_only_policies_in_detailed_mode: p1ep4/cons/unf2/multiref with the detailed prompt write one sentence (mean sentences <= 1.03) and M within +-0.08 of their short mode
structural.ordering_is_not_a_test: L (no thresholds) predicts the recall order {p1, p1ep4, multiref} < {cons, unf2} < rnd2 < fuse2, identical to A1's tau order; A1's kill rule (Kendall tau-b < 0.6) cannot fail under L
structural.rank_test: human_parity.py rank (offline F1 vs trained F1, 6 policies): L's points give trained F1 fuse2 64.4 > rnd2 61.2 > unf2 58.5 >= cons 58.1 > p1 54.6 >= multiref 54.2, Kendall tau-b 0.87 (one swap, cons/unf2), range [0.73, 1.0]; a pass is therefore predicted by length alone
structural.joint_frontier_invariance: mean frontier residual over all landed ladder runs: 95% CI contains 0 and its point lies in [-0.8, +0.8] (per-run CIs are ~+-2 P at 558 images)
structural.selection_targets_stay_on_frontier: any target chosen for precision at equal recall offline (A1 Bayes dial, consensus) lands within +-1.0 P of the learner frontier, as e5 (best-of-6 self-samples) already does (-0.4/-0.3)
